# KAM Global AI

> KAM Global AI is a technology and workforce services company. It provides software development, AI and automation, data and analytics, cloud and DevOps, managed IT, HR and recruitment services, and global outsourcing, with technology delivery from India and business operations support from the Philippines. Engagement scope, models and commercial terms are agreed during scoping.

## Company
- [About KAM Global AI](https://kamglobalai.com/about): company overview, backing by KAM Group and delivery locations
- [Contact](https://kamglobalai.com/contact): enquiries for projects, proposals, talent and HR services
